citation.title: Accuracy of complete arch implant intraoral scans: A systematic review of different technique categories compared with the conventional splinted open tray method
citation.authors: Junying Li, Jiayi Lu, Zhaozhao Chen, Prajakta Shreeram Kulkarni, Yu Chun Lin, Fei Liu

s_design.anchor: SR/meta-analysis of predominantly in-vitro accuracy studies (22 of 23 in vitro, 1 clinical); bench accuracy question rerouted from DIAGNOSTIC to MATERIAL, took the MATERIAL SR/MA row (100, via Step 2 routing)
s_design.evidence_quote: Twenty-three studies, including 22 in vitro studies and 1 clinical study, were included in the present systematic review.

domains.evidence_quote: study protocol had been prospectively registered in the PROSPERO database (CRD420250645005)
A literature search was conducted across the PubMed, Web of Science, and EMBASE databases up to October 2025 using the search strategy shown in Table 3.
546 records were screened by title and abstract, 64 articles were assessed by full text, and 23 studies were included
domains.note: no per-study list of the 41 excluded full texts (Figure 3 gives aggregate reasons with counts only); but (a) screening account with counts and (b) inclusion/exclusion criteria (PICO, Table 1) are both reported, so 3b-iii branch 2

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: absence: read Methods in full (protocol, PICO, search, screening, data extraction, statistics), Results (PRISMA, Figure 5 caption, meta-analysis) and Discussion/Limitations; no risk-of-bias, critical appraisal or quality-assessment tool (QUIN, RoB, JBI, etc.) is named or applied. Figure 5 'Evidence quality' only sorts the 23 studies by study type (clinical, extraoral model, fitting vs scan measurement), which is a design classification and not an appraisal of bias in the individual studies. Extraction-artifact check: read the text blocks around Figures 3 and 5, no hidden appraisal wording

domains.evidence_quote: Pooled SMDs were calculated using random-effects meta-analysis to avoid potential bias.

domains.note: absence: read Methods statistics paragraph (SMD, random-effects, I2, Cochrane Q, effect size interpretation), Results meta-analysis section and Discussion/Limitations; no funnel plot, Egger or other small-study/publication-bias assessment and no wording on publication bias anywhere in the text (checked for ligature/broken-word artifacts)

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement / commercial manufacturer funding
penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
penalties.note: COI statement present; no funding by a manufacturer stated (work of an AAFP committee, a non-profit academic society)

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: not an RCT; the review itself was prospectively registered (PROSPERO)

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: source text makes no survival/success claim and does not address follow-up duration; outcomes are scan accuracy (trueness, precision, vertical gap)

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۳۰ از ۱۰۰ و باند آن D (شواهد ضعیف) برای پرسش از نوع MATERIAL است.
sources.interpretation_fa: این مرور سیستماتیک پروتکل ثبت‌شده و جست‌وجوی سه‌پایگاهی دارد، اما ارزیابی خطای سوگیری مطالعات واردشده و سنجش سوگیری انتشار در آن گزارش نشده است. ۲۲ مطالعه از ۲۳ مطالعه آزمایشگاهی بودند. الگوی کلی نشان می‌دهد اسکن داخل‌دهانی در فاصله کوتاه ایمپلنت دقتی برابر یا بهتر و در فاصله بلند دقتی کمتر از قالب‌گیری open tray دارد.
